lines: Faculty of Social Science - Geography and Environment

Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 course from Geography and Environment 1100, Geography and Environment 1200A/B, Geography and Environment 1300A/B, Geography and Environment 1400F/G or Geography and Environment 1500F/G, Environmental Science 1021F/G with a mark of at least 60% in each of these courses.

If upper-year students have not completed 1.0 course listed above, they may select one or two courses from: Geography and Environment 2131A/B, Geography and Environment 2132A/B, Geography and Environment 2133A/B, Geography and Environment 2152F/G, and/or Geography and Environment 2153A/B in making up the 1.0 admission requirement, as long as they were completed with a grade of at least 60%. Senior qualifying entry course(s) cannot be counted for subsequent program credit.
2.0 courses: Geography and Environment 2411F/G, Geography and Environment 2430A/B, Geography and Environment 3431A/B, Geography and Environment 3432A/B.
1.0 course from: Geography and Environment 2210A/B,Geography and Environment 2220A/B, Geography and Environment 2230A/B, Geography and Environment 3250A/B.

0.5 course from: Geography and Environment 2152F/G, Geography and Environment 2153A/B, Geography and Environment 2156A/B, Geography and Environment 2160A/B, Geography and Environment 2162A/B, Geography and Environment 2412F/G, Geography and Environment 2420A/B, Geography and Environment 2460F/G, Sociology 2180A/B, Psychology 2036A/B.
0.5 course from: Geography and Environment 2131A/B, Geography and Environment 2133A/B, Geography and Environment 2310A/B, Geography and Environment 2320A/B, Geography and Environment 2330A/B.

1.0 course from: Geography and Environment 3413F/G, Geography and Environment 3441F/G, Geography and Environment 3443F/G, Geography and Environment 3445F/G, Geography and Environment 3446F/G, Geography and Environment 3461F/G, Geography and Environment 3462F/G, Geography and Environment 3463F/G, Anthropology 3341F/G.
1.0 course in Geography and Environment at the 3000 level or above.
1. Combination with a Major module in Science or Basic Medical Sciences may allow graduation with a Four-Year BSc.
2. To qualify for a Four-Year BSc degree, 11.0 Science and/or Science equivalent courses are required.

3. When taken within this module, the following Geography and Environment courses count toward the requirement of 11.0 Science courses in a Four-Year BSc: Geography and Environment 2131A/B, Geography and Environment 2133A/B, Geography and Environment 2210A/B, Geography and Environment 2220A/B, Geography and Environment 2230A/B, Geography and Environment 2310A/B, Geography and Environment 2320A/B, Geography and Environment 2330A/B, Geography and Environment 3222A/B, Geography and Environment 3224A/B, Geography and Environment 3231A/B, Geography and Environment 3311A/B, Geography and Environment 3334A/B, Geography and Environment 3350A/B, Geography and Environment 3352A/B, Geography and Environment 3354A/B, Geography and Environment 4210A/B, Geography and Environment 4211A/B, Geography and Environment 4221A/B, and Geography and Environment 4350A/B, Geography and Environment 4901E, the former Geography 3210A/B, the former Geography 3211A/B, the former Geography 3223A/B, the former Geography 3226A/B, the former Geography 3353A/B.
This module may NOT be combined with any other Geography and Environment module.
